summary: Tested all 5 features from TAG-2-GARDEN PATCH: Shoulder Bag discard bug fix, Activity Bar PNG icons, StatusModal GP hint, Collect Wood/Stone floating reward, and TH-Protection discard guard. All passed.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver warning on web: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-breaking - animation still works.

critical_code_review_comments: PlayerBag.tsx: handleSlotPress() correctly opens discard dialog on EVERY short tap in garden context (setDiscardTarget) with no blocking flag - correct.
PlayerBag.tsx: handleDiscardNo() simply sets discardTarget=null with no lingering state - reopens cleanly on next tap.
PlayerBag.tsx: discardLocked = dayIdx <= 3 (MO=0, TU=1, WE=2, TH=3) triggers thought bubble 'We still need it.' instead of actual discard - correct TH-protection.
ActivityBar.tsx: ACTIVITY_ICONS map uses well.png, wood.png, stone.png, workout2.png - 0 SVG/Ionicons confirmed.
StatusModal.tsx: gpHint style shows '10 Growth Points needed.' in smaller text (fontSize:10, opacity:0.45) below Growth Points label - correct.
garden.tsx: triggerActionFlash(IMG.wood, '+1') renders 120x120 wood.png + green '#44CC44' +1 text; woodLocked.current prevents double-reward - correct.
garden.tsx: triggerActionFlash(IMG.stone, '+1') same pattern for stone - correct.
calcEffectiveStaminaCost(5, endurance=1) = Math.max(1, 5 - floor(1/5)) = 5 stamina per collect - correctly deducted.
